description: Fork of exp713 (1.4244 @ 84.94M, soft-trained 8K then hard-finetuned 4K = 12K total steps). Ablation: train in hard mode from SCRATCH for 12000 steps (matched total compute), no checkpoint init. backward_mode='soft' (single-row argmax hard forward + K-row soft backward, same as exp713). Tests: is the soft warmup load-bearing, or can hard-from-scratch at matched compute reach the same place? Reference data: exp687 (hard from scratch 8K) = 1.4643 (lost vs exp706 1.4371). This run gets 50% more compute (12K vs 8K) and matches exp713's total compute exactly. If exp714 < exp713, soft warmup is not needed; if exp714 >> exp713, soft init was the key. All other hyperparams identical to exp713/exp706.
